viewpoint.question: Does an added line contain an API key, token, password or private key written as a literal string, for example a value starting with sk-, ghp_, AIza, AKIA or xoxb-, or a long random alphanumeric value?
viewpoint.exception: Ignore test or documentation values that contain dummy, test, sample or xxxx.
Ignore the apiKey inside a JavaScript firebaseConfig object.

viewpoint.question: Does an added line put an external value into an SQL statement by concatenation or interpolation (+, ||, f-string, format, %, template literal)?
viewpoint.exception: Ignore concatenation of constants defined in the code.
Ignore values passed through placeholders such as ?, $1 or :name.

viewpoint.question: Does an added line run a shell command string that contains an external value, through os.system, subprocess with shell=True, child_process.exec, backticks, or ${{ github.event.* }} / ${{ github.head_ref }} written directly inside a GitHub Actions run: step?
viewpoint.exception: Ignore test code (files under tests/ or named test_*).

viewpoint.question: Does an added line execute an external value as code with eval, exec, new Function or Function()?
viewpoint.exception: Ignore test code (files under tests/ or named test_*).

viewpoint.question: Does an added line insert an external value into the page HTML through innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, document.write, dangerouslySetInnerHTML or v-html?
Does an added line pipe a script downloaded from the network straight into a shell, written as curl ... | bash, curl ... | sh, wget -O- ... | sh or iex (irm ...)?
Does an added line run rm -rf, rm -r or Remove-Item -Recurse on a path built from a variable that can be empty, without quotes or a ${VAR:?} check?
Does an added line catch or ignore a failure and do nothing, written as except: pass, catch (e) {}, || true, try?, an error return assigned to _, or continue-on-error: true?
viewpoint.exception: Ignore cases that log the error and then continue.
Ignore cases that only ignore 'already gone' errors such as FileNotFoundError.
Ignore failures of cleanup code such as close() inside finally.

viewpoint.question: Does an added line contain debug output labeled DEBUG (print, console.log, NSLog, fmt.Println, puts) or a TODO that says to remove it later or marks it temporary?
viewpoint.exception: Ignore test code (files under tests/ or named test_*).
Ignore output that a CLI main function prints to show results to the user.

viewpoint.question: Does an added line call a pay-per-use API (generative AI, image, video or speech generation) with no spending or count limit checked before the call?
Does an added loop use an end condition that is off by one from the array bounds, written as i <= len(xs), i <= arr.length, i <= len(xs) in Go, or range(0, len(xs) - 1)?
Does an added if or while condition contain an assignment (=) where a comparison (== or ===) was meant?
Does added SQL compare with NULL using = NULL or != NULL instead of IS NULL?
Does an added line start a while True, while (true) or for (;;) waiting loop that has neither a retry limit nor a timeout?
Does an added line open a file or connection with open(), fopen, os.Open or sql.Open and use it without closing it through with, defer, try-with-resources or finally?
